steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Stop your futile resistance right now!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Your actions this night are unlawful! Admit your wrongdoing!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: We don't want to hurt you! Cooperate—

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Blyat! You hit me!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Filthy beasts! Lunatics!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: All streets surrounding the ballroom are under control. We have the suspects in custody here.

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Madness... utter madness.

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Students out of school, Armies out of their regions... is anyone in Ursus where they should be?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Should we take them in for questioning?

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: You can't say you don't recognize their uniforms! How many commoners do you think there could be in those schools?

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: You want to take all these noble sons and daughters back to the station, and wait for the counts and dukes to show up to claim them?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: So... do we just let them go?

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Use your brain, mudak! There might be assassins among them. Who am I supposed to hand over to the council if they come looking, you?

spans.text: There might be assassins among them. Who am I supposed to hand over to the council if they come looking, you?

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Gosudar... one more year and I'll be in the Duma and out of this hellhole...

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Why did it have to be now? Damn it all!

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: How much room do we have in the prisons?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Well, if we clear out everyone who's about to lose their head, we might have room for—

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: ...Think carefully. Can our prisons really take so many?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Uh... maybe not?

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: Of course, of course.

steps.name: Police Superintendent
steps.text: But I know the perfect place to hold these lawless lunatics...

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Gosudar-batyushka... can someone tell me how I come back to this trash heap to find a dozen trucks filled with kids waiting for me?

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: Oh, the police say they're out of space in the jails and needed to borrow Katorga for these prisoners who were causing trouble at the ball.

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: Never seen the cops so polite! And they left you a letter.

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: 'Honorable'... 'Katorga'... 'useless things'...

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Give it to me. I'll read it myself.

a.text: Katorga is already holding plenty of useless things. A few more will hardly make a difference.

spans.text: Katorga is already holding plenty of useless things. A few more will hardly make a difference.

a.text: My regards on behalf of Duke Treplev.

spans.text: My regards on behalf of Duke Treplev.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: 'Useless things'? That fool of a superintendent has no idea how valuable this opportunity is.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Bring me Gromov. I will be making numerous visits to important people starting tomorrow. He's in charge while I'm away.

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: Boss got drunk last night, he's not up yet—there must be something in that backstreet bar's drinks!

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Mudak, how much am I paying you scum to keep the peace?

spans.text: , how much am I paying you scum to keep the peace?

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Dump a bucket of ice water on his head NOW, and tell him to take good care of our guests.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Not one musbeast gets out of Katorga without my say-so.

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: You want us to 'take care' of them? You want them alive, or?

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: My dear Khvoin, I know your little brain can't handle complex instructions, so I'm trying to use language that even YOU will understand.

spans.text: , I know your little brain can't handle complex instructions, so I'm trying to use language that even YOU will understand.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Do NOT engage in your usual habits. Do NOT touch a single hair on these people's heads... you understand who 'these people' are, don't you?

steps.name: Hired Muscle
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Do not forget who pays you the money that you waste in those dirty little bars. And don't you dare forget my words.

steps.name: Pavlovich
steps.text: Their lives have been worth more than yours since the day they were born into their noble names.

a.text: My luck had been really good ever since I ran into Antosha's guys.
I got separated from the others in the crowd that night. Maybe I was just too small, but the cops didn't notice me, and I got out of there on my own.
I didn't know if I would ever see Antosha's crew again. Katorga was completely locked down after that night, and there was no way in.
I thought maybe I was meant to be back on the streets...
It didn't take long for me to decide.
I would go look for them.
Energy pipelines can never be completely blocked off, no matter where you are.
I make a good sewer musbeast.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Phew... almost there.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Good... didn't see anyone on the way... don't seem to be any guards around...
Hmm... is there somebody behind me?
Hello?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You scared me!

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Who are you? Why are you in the energy pipes—I mean, I'm here too, but you gotta explain!
Oh, I can explain later, but right now, I could really use some help...
I think I might have misjudged the width of this pipeline before I squeezed in.
Could you maybe give me a push?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Fine... not like I can get out if I don't.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You push too. Hrgh—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Phew... thanks.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I didn't think there'd be somebody else sneaking in with me. Are you looking for someone too?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You too?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: My friends got arrested a couple of days ago. I heard they might be inside, so I came to check it out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm Rosalind, but my friends call me Leto. What about you?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Ukusik... stupid name that my friends gave me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ukusik! That's easy to remember.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is your friend with the Student Assembly?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Student Assembly? Never heard of it. We've got our own name, the Unbound!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Cool name! But I've never heard it either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I figure they must be good people, if you're crawling through energy pipes to help them.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: They're... really good people. And my home is here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Home?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Excuse me! Have you seen any other students around here?

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Good heavens, did you just crawl out of the sewers or something?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, yeah actually.

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Alright, that's close enough. We can talk at this distance. Gosudar...

spans.text: Alright, that's close enough. We can talk at this distance.

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Wait, you're from the Self-Government Group... I almost mistook you for those Unbound tramps.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Unbound...

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Rude, uncouth ruffians... their leader is the worst of the lot. Who does he think he is, acting like he's in charge? What titles do his parents hold?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You saw Antosha? Where are they?!

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Just go east from here, and you'll find them behind those filthy factory buildings.

steps.name: Calm Noble Student
steps.text: Don't thank me, just... keep moving.

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: Naum... why don't we go back?

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: We don't know the situation, and those thugs don't look like they can be reasoned with... besides, I heard there are already students who have gone missing.

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: Enough, 'Pencil Stub'. You want to hang out with those peasants, you go back on your own. I will not stay and listen to another uncouth word they say.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Hey! Why are you talking about them like that?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What's going on? Who locked you up? What's up with this factory?

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: We have no idea. The cops grabbed us the night before last outside the ballroom. We're not sure why they took us here.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: No cops in this place, but it's patrolled by some street thugs. I overheard them say that the man in charge is named Pavlovich...

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: I'll remember that. There will be hell to pay when I get out of here.

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: We must be here by some mistake. I don't know how the misunderstanding happened, but I don't plan on accepting his apology so easily.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: Did you sneak in from outside? Is there a way out?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You could get out through the energy pipes, but I'm not sure if big guys like you will fit.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: Maybe we, er...

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: What? You want to crawl through these pipes that can barely fit a musbeast?

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: I guarantee somebody will be here to pick us up soon.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Shh—someone's coming!

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: I swear I saw something go past!

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: You swear? Hah, mochi perkhoti, just fart next time, at least you'll make a sound!

spans.text: , just fart next time, at least you'll make a sound!

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: What a waste of time! Even tuskbeasts know to look for a dry slope to dig a hole in on a day like this, and we gotta watch this stupid hole on this ugly wall!

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: You still got booze?

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: Blyat, stop drinking! We only need to watch this hole for another day, then someone will be here to fill it up. You give me that look again, and I'll smash your skull with this bottle!

spans.text: , stop drinking! We only need to watch this hole for another day, then someone will be here to fill it up. You give me that look again, and I'll smash your skull with this bottle!

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Oh, you wanna see whose skull is harder? Go on, try. You better kill me in one hit, because if you don't, I'm gonna kill you and sell your skin to Gromov for booze.

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: (Seething) Alright, you want a fight, you'll get one! Chort, I love your crazy. Say, you wanna try some wine made from blood?

spans.text: (Seething) Alright, you want a fight, you'll get one!
, I love your crazy. Say, you wanna try some wine made from blood?

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Human blood? You can make wine from human blood?

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: Tuskbeast blood, dura. Whose blood did you think it was, mine? I'm not as crazy as you.

spans.text: . Whose blood did you think it was, mine? I'm not as crazy as you.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Say... how far do we have to haul this?

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: Beats me. Hide it where nobody goes. Pavlovich won't let us do this stuff.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: I hate taking orders from that mudak.

spans.text: I hate taking orders from that

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: What can you say, he pays the bills.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: I'm tired. What do these students eat? How did they get so fat?

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Hey, I've got an idea.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: There's a hole here, and we've got a thing. We put the thing in the hole—

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: And we'll be free to go drink.

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: You're a damned genius!

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: Come, I'll take you to my vodka stash.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Oh, how sweet. Come, lemme give you a big, warm hug...

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: What are they doing...?

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: What's in that sack?
They watch from the shadows as the thugs stuff a filled sack into the pipeline.

The sack gets stuck, and the woman irritably pulls it open, revealing black pants and shoes covered in mud and dirt—looking suspiciously like a school uniform. She tries to stuff the leg deeper into the sack.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Whispers) Shh! Shut up!

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: I told you, I saw something.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: Sure, sure, smart guy.

steps.name: Male Thug
steps.text: Pavlovich says we can't kill them.

steps.name: Female Thug
steps.text: He was talking about the nobles, mudak... besides, there must be hundreds of them. He wouldn't know if a few went missing.

spans.text: He was talking about the nobles,
... besides, there must be hundreds of them. He wouldn't know if a few went missing.

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: You... you're going to...

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll hold them off! Go on without me—

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Don't be a hero! Look at their weapons!

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Run—!

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Did you see how many there were?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: We would have been screwed if we fought them!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Are these the people watching over this turf?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who are they? Why do they have military-grade weapons, if they're not cops?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: No idea. Here, they're the same as the police... all meanies.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Didn't you say Antosha's guys were here? I didn't see them.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Looks like this one's scared stupid.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Hey, Leto, we gotta find a way to get around this corner. Do you see those two—

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Block 7 clear. You can come out and clean now.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Antosha! Found you!

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Ukusik?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: What are you doing here? I thought you got away that night—

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: You're alive! Some people said you're dead, some people said you got locked up, I didn't know what to do.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Where's Matvey? Are you alright? Are you listening to me?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: We're fine. We'll be even finer if you raise your voice any louder and draw the attention of those thugs.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Hey! Stop making fun of me!

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: We're fine. Matvey, Yura... everyone's here.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Ukusik!

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Uwah...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Well... glad you're alright.

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: You... you killed people...

steps.name: Naum
steps.text: You're barbarians... murderers...

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Where are you going? Come back!

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Forget him... where did you find this fool?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Picked him up over there.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: This is not a shelter. We don't have time for people like these.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: So we chase them away? Is it okay if those thugs kill them?

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Antosha, you need to be careful. You may not care whether he lives or dies, but allowing him to run around may draw unwanted attention.

steps.name: Unbound Member
steps.text: Antosha! Someone's coming!

steps.name: Unbound Member
steps.text: She's armed, and there's blood on her weapon. She looks dangerous.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Just one? I'll deal with her.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait, she's not a threat—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: General!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I thought those bastards had rounded up all the students in the area. Looks like you've protected a good bunch.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Your name's Antosha? I'm Sonya.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: You're a student at University of Deity Grypherburg too?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not exactly... but I'm working with them, for now.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I heard your people surrounded the ballroom that night just to shout a few slogans.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, it wasn't the best idea.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't know Grypherburg so well... what can you tell me about what's going on? What is this place?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: This is Katorga Raion, a former penal industrial plate. It's been derelict for a long time, and even the power supply has been cut.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I heard the city was planning to abandon the place entirely and discard it in the wilderness.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But there are so many people here now, including us...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I'm guessing it's because of the aristocratic students on your side.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: The police didn't want to have to deal with them, so they sent you here... Katorga is nominally a place for the government to hold criminals, after all.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright. I guess it's not that complicated.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: The problem is, Katorga is now being run by a bunch of lunatics.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Armed with weapons that no one knows how they got, killing for the sheer fun of it... something seems to be holding them back, for now, but no one knows what will happen if things continue on like this.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Maybe we can work together.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: How many people do you have?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well... they're not exactly my people, but there are around two hundred students trapped here with me.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Spoiled nobles aren't good for much, no matter how many there are.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I'm in no position to protect you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: General Zima doesn't need your protection!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: At least we want the same thing, for now. And if you can trust what you just saw me do, you can believe that we'll fight those thugs and get out of here together.
Sonya is silent for a long time, then takes a big step forward, and Antosha follows at almost the same time.
Antosha extends his hand first.
Sonya takes it. They shake hands briefly, then quickly break apart.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Sorry for attacking you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's all good. Fists can talk, and yours told me you're an okay guy. Where did you learn your moves?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Plenty of opportunities on the streets.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Let me make this clear: just because we're working together doesn't make us allies. Our camps will remain separate, but we can spare you some supplies.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Much appreciated. We will do as you say, and make these supplies count. We can discuss joint operations when the time comes.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Deal. See you around, Sonya.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: And take your friends... minus one now, I suppose.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: (Shivers)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Thank you for protecting them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Thanks for the help, little Ukusik.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Don't call me that—

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Ugh, never mind. You be careful. See ya.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You look terrible, General! Are you alright?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm fine... how's everyone? Anybody hurt?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Zoya's got a scratch, but nothing serious.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I didn't think you would come in here on your own... did Istina plan this?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Couldn't wait for a plan. I was afraid it might be too late, so I left a note and came.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sorry for acting without permission. If you're mad—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thank you, Leto.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, not so tight! That's maybe a little too much... Sonya?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Are you...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Are you scared?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't be stupid.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's alright! I'm here now. Put us together, and we can take down anything.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If two fists won't do it, add two more!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Besides, there are so many people out there, and so many more fists!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Good point, Leto.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I won't be scared anymore.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: 'Sonya.' The name is unfamiliar to us. She was not one of them.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I know. I won't take it out on her.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: ...I'm just reminded of the professor.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Same here, Antosha.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Do you remember why I was the first person you thought of when you formed the Unbound?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: You were one of the few in the old gang who came from commoner stock. You knew hardship, knew how to produce, and how to survive in Ursus.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Yes, survive. Only through survival can we achieve our ideals. We have to get out of this alive.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: The others need your command now. You must pull yourself together.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Yura, why does Antosha look so terrible?

steps.name: Yura
steps.text: That one's wearing a Student Assembly badge. That was our design, from back when we were all in the Petrachevsky Group.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: The Petrachevsky Group? What's that?

steps.name: Yura
steps.text: No one told you? Antosha was the first leader of the Petrachevsky Group. After the death of our professor, we were reported by the other students and expelled.

steps.name: Yura
steps.text: But others escaped punishment because of their upbringing, and they continue to do stupid, despicable things under the group's old name.

steps.name: Yura
steps.text: Especially their leader, Olga! We will never forgive her!

steps.name: Whispering Noble B
steps.text: This Petrachevsky Group... several dukes had children in it, and a group went to His Imperial Majesty to beg for amnesty.

steps.name: Whispering Noble A
steps.text: Wait a second.

steps.name: Whispering Noble A
steps.text: Who's this Petrachevsky?

steps.name: Whispering Noble B
steps.text: Professor of Literature at the University of Deity Grypherburg, and one of those traitors who printed pamphlets slandering the tsar. How could you not know the name?

steps.name: Whispering Noble A
steps.text: There are more traitors in the universities than papers they've published! How am I supposed to remember them all?

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Order!

steps.name: Hearing Committee Member
steps.text: (Whisper) Your Honor, the next two witnesses are of the nobility. They may need more time to prepare...

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: While some of this information has already been made public, we will now once again review Sonya's deeds in Katorga Raion...
